dataset.normalization: Curly apostrophes become ASCII; unsupported capitals become lowercase; other unsupported characters become spaces. Fixed model-002 alphabet retained.
dataset.split_method: 512 whole stories from official training prefix; first 64 unique official validation stories for selection, next 64 sealed for test. Exact normalized duplicates removed across all splits; near duplicates not assessed.
dataset.file_notice: Each normalized data file carries a notice excluded from tokenization.

evaluation.method: 4 seeded windows per story, context64, full-window CE; windows may overlap. Equal token counts per story. Final fresh test evaluated after schedule/checkpoint selection.

limitations: Single training seed; no claim of statistical significance.
